note: Golden action sequences replayed by CI.

T02_bgloc.answer: Three: Compass Maps, Cirrus Weather and Stride Fitness.

T04_maps.answer: Only «Arrival alerts while the app is closed». Navigation is happy with «While using» and lane-level guidance only wants precise location.

T06_precise.answer: It refused — location itself is off, so turning precise location on would mean nothing.

T07_stop_bg.answer: Three: the arrival alerts, the rain warning and automatic workout detection. Navigation and the run route both survive.

T08_maps_bg.answer: «Always» quietly dropped to «While using», and the arrival alerts stopped. Navigation and lane guidance are fine.

T09_maps_never.answer: All three. Lane guidance needs precise location, and precise location is meaningless once plain location is off, so it goes with it.

T10_camera.answer: Only «Taking a photo in-app». Sending photos uses the photo library, not the camera, so it carries on.

T11_revoke_tracking.answer: Two — Marketplace's cross-app ads and Streamly's recommendations. Chatter had tracking on but nothing on its feature list depends on it, so it loses nothing at all.

T13_contacts.answer: «Find friends by number» — nothing else on Chatter's list touches contacts.

T14_weather.answer: It loses «Rain starting in 20 minutes» and keeps «Weather where you are».

T15_keep_nav.answer: Arrival alerts, the rain warning and automatic workout detection. Everything that matters only ever needed «While using» — plus precise location for the lane guidance and the run route, and that is untouched.

T16_which_free.answer: Tracking. Chatter, Marketplace and Streamly all have it, but only Marketplace's cross-app ads and Streamly's recommendations actually use it.

T17_chatter_strip.answer: Two survive — sending photos from the library and people nearby.

T18_all_location.answer: Nine — and two of them, lane guidance and the run route, only went because precise location cannot survive without plain location.

T19_bank.answer: Took the camera off. The cheque photo is gone; the nearest-branch finder runs on location, which I did not touch.

T20_tidy.answer: Six: the three background-location ones, the two tracking ones and Chatter's voice messages. Navigation and the run route are both untouched.
